headline: Lagos Unveils 2052 Economic Development Plan Targeting $1 Trillion GDP
summary: Nigeria's commercial capital Lagos unveiled a long-term economic development strategy targeting a $1 trillion economy by 2052 to attract capital and enhance its status as an international financial center.
why: Lagos is the economic powerhouse of West Africa, generating a significant portion of Nigeria's non-oil gross domestic product and financial activity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Long-term investment targeting infrastructure and financial services aims to stimulate regional GDP growth.
